rationale: The provided excerpts from EASA NPA 2025-07(B) explicitly confirm the scope exclusions for AI systems contributing to fatalities, multiple life-threatening injuries, and certain online-learning cases (DS.AI.010). The claim accurately reflects the proposed material within its strictly defined scope.
limitations: The claim relies on proposed material (NPA 2025-07(B)); a final EASA decision, CRD, or successor AMC/GM must be verified before publication to ensure the framework's final status.
